scripts.text: Only users between Levels ^ff000030 ~ 80^000000 can enter this Dungeon.
scripts.translation: 只有等级在 ^ff000030 ~ 80^000000 之间的玩家才能进入该地下城。

scripts.text: Party status confirmed. Would you like to book entrance to the {0}?
scripts.translation: 队伍状态确认完毕。您想要预约进入 {0} 吗？

scripts.text: Reserve the {0}
scripts.translation: 预约 {0}

scripts.text: Enter the Dungeon
scripts.translation: 进入地下城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^0000ff{0}^000000- Attempting to book an entrance
After making a reservation, you have to select 'Enter the Dungeon' from the menu if you wish to enter the {1}.
scripts.translation:
^0000ff{0}^000000- 正在尝试预约进入
完成预约后，如果您想进入 {1}，需要从菜单中选择“进入地下城”。

scripts.text: {0} Enter the Memorial Dungeon
scripts.translation: {0} 进入记忆地下城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You can enter the Dungeon if it has been generated.
scripts.translation: 如果地下城已经生成，您就可以进入。

scripts.text: Enter the Dungeon {0}
scripts.translation: 进入地下城 {0}

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: ^0000ffAll records and after-effects related to the Orc's Memory Dungeon are deleted. You can now regenerate or re-enter the dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff与兽人记忆地下城相关的所有记录和后续效果已被删除。您现在可以重新生成或重新进入地下城。^000000

scripts.text: In order to generate a dungeon you must be the Party Leader and have at least 2 members in the party.
scripts.translation: 为了生成地下城，您必须是队伍首领，且队伍中至少有2名成员。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
Memorial Dungeon Orc's Memory does not exist.
Memorial Dungeon has been destroyed by the Party Leader, or because of the time limit. Please try again after 2 hours.
scripts.translation:
记忆地下城“兽人记忆”不存在。
记忆地下城已被队伍首领摧毁，或因时间限制而消失。请在2小时后再试。

scripts.text: Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation: 只有队伍成员才能进入记忆地下城。

scripts.text: The Mad Scientist doesn't seem to notice you and keeps mumbling to himself...
scripts.translation: 疯狂科学家似乎没有注意到你，他一直在自言自语...

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Haha, no Orcs are coming near me!
The power of the Dimensional Gorge is undefeatable!!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
哈哈，没有兽人会靠近我！
次元峡谷的力量是无敌的！！

scripts.text: Orcs don't attack you?
scripts.translation: 兽人不攻击你吗？

scripts.text: You wish!
scripts.translation: 你做梦吧！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Yeah, yeah.. I know it's hard to belive. I don't blame ya.
I used to study the Dimensional Gorge discovered near Morocc.
According to my research, the minerals found there have enormous power inside them!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
是是是...我知道这很难让人相信。我不怪你。
我曾经研究过在莫洛克附近发现的次元峡谷。
根据我的研究，那里发现的矿石蕴含着巨大的力量！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
You are a pretty distrustful person, huh?
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
你真是个多疑的人，不是吗？

scripts.text: Oh? Like what, travel to alternate space?
scripts.translation: 哦？比如，前往异次元空间？

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Very smart! I have actually just done that! See that statue over there? It's not your normal Monolith!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
真聪明！我刚才正好做了这个！看到那边那座雕像了吗？它可不是普通的独石！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
I have created it with a combination of our technology and the unlimited energy I discovered from the Gorge! Want to try it?
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
我利用我们的科技，结合从峡谷中发现的无限能量制造了它。想试试吗？

scripts.text: ...Um, that doesn't sound legal?
scripts.translation: ...呃，这听起来不合法吧？

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Hey, since when did something so interesting have to be legal!? How about it! You can talk to the Orcs! C'mon!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
嘿，这么有趣的事情什么时候需要合法了？怎么样！你可以和兽人说话了！来吧！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Chances are they'll just give you lots of instructions once they see you, so just wing it! They're always saying the same thing, to the point where I memorized them!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
他们看到你后，大概只会给你一堆指示，所以随便应付一下就行！他们总是说同样的话，我都背下来了！

scripts.text: Alright... What do I do?
scripts.translation: 好吧...我该怎么做？

scripts.text: Umm, maybe not.
scripts.translation: 呃，还是算了。

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Very good! Just sit in the hands of this statue! And try to act natural when you're in there!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
很好！只要坐在这座雕像的手里！进去后试着表现得自然一点！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Oh fine, be that way!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
哦，随你吧！

scripts.text:
[Mad Scientist]
Hmm? Put your hand on that Monemus Statue if you want to experience traveling through dimensions!
scripts.translation:
[疯狂科学家]
嗯？如果你想体验穿越维度的感觉，把手放在那座莫内雕像上吧！

scripts.text:
[Kruger]
*Coughing*
{0}, it's you...

[{0}] 
Don't move! You are wounded!
scripts.translation:
[{0}] 
别动！你受伤了！

scripts.text:
[Kruger]
It's... all right.. I'm dying...
....
The Shaman? What about the Shaman?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁格]
没...没事...我要死了...
....
萨满？萨满怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[{0}] 
The Shaman's dead now. Who was that Shaman really?
scripts.translation:
[{0}] 
萨满已经死了。那个萨满到底是谁？

scripts.text: Kruger seemed to be relieved as he hears of the death of the Shaman, but you notice the bitter expression on his face.
scripts.translation: 克鲁格听到萨满的死讯似乎松了一口气，但你注意到他脸上带着苦涩的表情。

scripts.text:
[Kruger]
I.. I just couldn't kill my own daughter...
Thank you, I'm sure she's finally free from the nightmare that used to choke her soul.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁格]
我...我只是无法杀死自己的女儿...
谢谢你，我相信她终于从那个折磨她灵魂的梦魇中解脱了。

scripts.text: Kruger was about to say something more, but he breathed his last breath before he could...
scripts.translation: 克鲁格似乎还想说些什么，但在说完之前便咽了气...

scripts.text: You can see the dead body of Kruger, peacefully lying on the ground.
scripts.translation: 你可以看到克鲁格的尸体，安详地躺在地上。
